# fopost_workspace (Resource)

A FoPost workspace: the tenant boundary every connected account, label, webhook, and automation is scoped to. Plans cap how many workspaces an account may hold, so creating one past the limit fails with a subscription error.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "fopost_workspace" "acme" {
  name        = "Acme Social"
  slug        = "acme-social"
  type        = "TEAM"
  timezone    = "Europe/Berlin"
  language    = "en"
  country     = "DE"
  website     = "https://acme.example.com"
  description = "Everything Acme publishes."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the workspace.
- `slug` (String) URL-safe identifier, unique across the account.

### Optional

- `country` (String) ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. `DE`.
- `description` (String) Free-text description of the workspace.
- `language` (String) Primary content language as an ISO 639-1 code, e.g. `en`. The API picks a default when this is omitted.
- `logo` (String) URL of the workspace logo.
- `timezone` (String) IANA time zone that scheduled posts in this workspace are read in, e.g. `Europe/Berlin`. The API picks a default when this is omitted.
- `type` (String) What the workspace represents. One of `PERSONAL`, `TEAM`, `ORGANIZATION`, `CLIENT`, `PROJECT`, `DEPARTMENT`, `EVENT`, `TEMPORARY`, `COMMUNITY`, `BRAND`, or `AGENCY`. The API picks a default when this is omitted.
- `website` (String) The brand's website.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of when the workspace was created.
- `id` (String) The workspace's server-assigned identifier.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the last change to the workspace.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A workspace is imported by its identifier, which you can read from the
# fopost_workspaces data source or the FoPost dashboard URL.
terraform import fopost_workspace.acme ws_01hzy8example
```
